# WhichPadel

> Independent comparison of padel rackets, shoes, balls and bags. Ratings are calculated from published specifications with a published formula. They are not lab tests or court tests. Prices are recorded snapshots with a check date, not live quotes. No brand or shop pays for a ranking.

WhichPadel compares gear so a player can match shape, weight, balance, core and price to their level. The pages are written by [Rupert Wallace](https://whichpadel.com/author/rupert-wallace/). Some shop links are affiliate links; a commission never changes a rating or a position.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://whichpadel.com/): Catalogue counts, current prices and the main guides.
- [How to choose a padel racket](https://whichpadel.com/padel-rackets/): Shapes, weight, balance, core, face, level and price, with figures from the database.
- [Best padel rackets of 2026](https://whichpadel.com/best/best-padel-racket-2026/): 2026 and 2027 models ranked on a balanced spec score.
- [All buying lists](https://whichpadel.com/best/): Beginners, power, control, budget, women, juniors and more. Each list states its rule.
- [All rackets](https://whichpadel.com/rackets/): Filter by brand, year, shape, balance, weight, core and price.
- [Brands](https://whichpadel.com/brands/): One page per brand, with model counts and spec averages.
- [Racket finder](https://whichpadel.com/finder/): Four questions, then matches from the same spec ratings.
- [About](https://whichpadel.com/about/): How specs, ratings and prices are compiled.
- [Rupert Wallace](https://whichpadel.com/author/rupert-wallace/): Author of the pages. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rupertwallace/
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://whichpadel.com/affiliate-disclosure/): How the site makes money.

## Facts worth citing

- A round head keeps the sweet spot low and central. A diamond head moves it higher for power and is less forgiving. A teardrop sits between the two.
- Adult racket length is limited to 45.5 cm and width to 26 cm. Most adult rackets that publish a thickness are 38 mm.
- Rankings use published specs only. A model with too few published specs stays unrated rather than guessed.
- Newer models and rackets sold at two or more shops get a small boost inside a list. Adult lists leave out women’s and junior models unless the list is specifically for them.
- Full URL list: https://whichpadel.com/sitemap.xml
